description: The plot illustrates the relative change across different layers, comparing various configurations. The x-axis is labeled with layer ranges (Layer5-12, Layer13-20, Layer21-28, and Layer29), indicating a categorical scale. The y-axis is labeled "Relative Change" with a linear scale, ranging from -15% to 5%, marked at intervals of 5%. The plot displays four lines: the yellow line with circle markers, labeled "LB-Avg of 2×tokens,8-bit", starts at around 2% and increases to approximately 4.5%; the red line with square markers, labeled "RULER4k of 2×tokens,8-bit", begins at about 1.8% and rises to around 4.3%; the light blue line with circle markers, labeled "RULER4k of 4×tokens,4-bit", starts at roughly 0% and increases to approximately 4%; and the dark blue line with square markers, labeled "Baseline of 4×tokens,4-bit", begins at around -2%, dips to about -14% at Layer13-20, and then sharply increases to around 2.5%. A dashed gray line is also present, labeled "Baseline of 4×tokens,4-bit", which remains relatively stable around 3-4%. Each line exhibits distinct trends across the layer ranges, with some displaying a steady increase and others showing more variability.
